letters.classification: A group is Latin when all 26 ASCII lowercase letters occur on its unmodified letter keys; otherwise its letter shortcuts use US positions.

digits.scope: All digit bindings, including bare tab digits and modified view and text-size chords; Shift remains an explicit shortcut modifier on AZERTY.

rules.when: A Latin group produces the character on its base or Shift level without AltGr, and that path conflicts with no binding in an overlapping frontend, preset or context scope.
A Latin group needs AltGr for the character, lacks it, or its printed path conflicts; the key at the US position is used, as for non-Latin letters.
A non-Latin group always uses the US position for punctuation.
Both alternatives conflict, or the only alternative conflicts. The cell stays an explicit punctuation-conflict row and is never waived.

punctuation.altgr_scope: An AltGr chord stays text input while editing and never dispatches a command; no command path holds AltGr.

groups: Resolve each active XKB group independently; UI language never selects a keyboard group.
modifiers: Record effective and consumed modifiers with XKB and GTK consumption modes. Character production may consume Shift or AltGr; explicit shortcut modifiers remain required.
dead_keys: A dead keysym is not a directly typed character. Composition is not a shortcut path.

terminal_protocols.legacy: No physical key identity or active group. Ctrl+I/Tab, Ctrl+M/Enter, Ctrl+[/Escape and Ctrl+Space/NUL are ambiguous; Ctrl+Shift letters collapse into Ctrl letters; Super and Ctrl+Enter are not portable.
terminal_protocols.modifyOtherKeys: Character and modifier reporting depends on terminal negotiation; physical US identity and active group are not guaranteed.
terminal_protocols.kitty: Alternate/base-layout key reporting requires negotiated flags and terminal support. Physical non-Latin shortcuts cannot be assumed from Unicode alone.
terminal_protocols.tmux: Extended keys depend on terminal and tmux settings; the legacy lane must retain reachable existing alternatives.

source_contract.conversion: default/input-methods/typing_setup.py and bin/omarchy-provision-owner, plus the recorded systemd kbd-model-map
source_contract.installer_count: Read from OMARCHY_KEYBOARD_LAYOUTS in the pinned setup-form.sh; never a literal.
